_comment: SINGLE machine-readable authority for the xInsp2 known-compatible set — the packages built + tested together. Both the in-artifact compat-manifest.json (generated by tools/compat_manifest.mjs into every release) and the README 'Known-compatible set' table are checked against THIS file. It records the tested-together SET; the individual current package versions still live in their own real sources (backend/CMakeLists.txt, vscode-extension/package.json, ui-components/package.json, tools/xinsp2_py/pyproject.toml, backend/include/xi/xi_abi.h). The self-check gate (tools/compat_manifest.test.mjs) asserts the pinned values below still match those real sources, so a version bump that forgets to update this file breaks loudly instead of shipping a stale matrix. Update this row when the tested-together set changes.

compat_ranges._comment: Advisory pre-1.0 ranges a consumer can check hello.data against. Kept next to the pinned set so the range and the tested point move together.
